# devbox.yaml reference

What does each value in `devbox.yaml` do? One row per key. Absent keys take the default. Unknown keys are an error.

| Key | Type | Default | Tier | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | string | *(required)* | identity | GCP project to build in. You need owner on it, or editor plus Project IAM Admin and Role Administrator. Exactly one of this or create_project. |
| `create_project` | bool | `false` | refused | Create the project, VPC and subnet. Backlogged: true is refused today. |
| `zone` | string | `europe-west4-a` | identity | Compute zone. The region is derived from it and must match the subnet's region. |
| `name` | string | `devbox` | identity | Box name. Every resource is named after it (NAME-code, NAME-allow-iap-ssh, ...) and labelled devbox=NAME. Also the Tailscale hostname and the service account ID. 6-30 chars, lowercase, digits, hyphens. |
| `network.name` | string | `default` | replace | An existing VPC network in the project. Never created or deleted. |
| `network.subnet` | string | `default` | replace | An existing subnet of that network, in the zone's region. |
| `machine_type` | string | `e2-standard-2` | restart | Compute machine type. Must be suspend-capable; E2 is the only family that reports guest memory without an agent. |
| `external_ip` | bool | `true` | in-place | Give the instance an ephemeral external IP for egress. Set false only if the subnet has Cloud NAT and Private Google Access. |
| `code_disk_gb` | integer | `50` | reprovision | Size of the /srv/code pet disk. Grow only; shrinking is refused. |
| `boot_disk_gb` | integer | `30` | reprovision | Size of the boot disk. Grow only; shrinking is refused. |
| `extra_packages` | list of string | `[]` | reprovision | Extra apt packages, usually language runtimes, installed by provision.sh. |
| `git.name` | string | *(required)* | reprovision | user.name in the rendered /etc/gitconfig. |
| `git.email` | string | *(required)* | reprovision | user.email in /etc/gitconfig and /etc/devbox/allowed_signers. |
| `tailscale.tag` | string | `tag:devbox` | reprovision | ACL tag the node advertises. Must be owned by the OAuth client. |
| `tailscale.oauth_secret` | string | `devbox-tailscale-oauth` | reprovision | Secret Manager secret holding the Tailscale OAuth client secret. Must start with devbox-. |
| `ssh_key.secret` | string | `devbox-ssh-key` | reprovision | Secret Manager secret holding the machine ed25519 private key, loaded into the system ssh-agent at boot. Must start with devbox-. |
| `snapshots.start_time` | string | `03:00` | in-place | Daily snapshot time of the code disk, UTC, on the hour (HH:00). |
| `snapshots.retention_days` | integer | `14` | in-place | Days each snapshot is kept. Snapshots outlive the disk. |
| `alerts.email` | string | *(empty)* | in-place | Address of the email notification channel. Empty disables all alerting resources. |
| `alerts.cpu_high_pct` | integer | `80` | in-place | Alert when CPU stays above this percentage for 5 minutes. |
| `alerts.cpu_idle_pct` | integer | `5` | in-place | Alert when a running box stays below this percentage for 6 hours, which means idle suspend has failed. |
| `alerts.disk_used_pct` | integer | `85` | in-place | Alert when /srv/code is fuller than this percentage. |
| `idle_suspend.enabled` | bool | `true` | reprovision | Suspend the box after a period with no attached tmux clients, SSH or mosh connections or claude processes. |
| `idle_suspend.after_minutes` | integer | `60` | reprovision | Idle minutes before the box suspends itself. |
| `break_glass.enabled` | bool | `false` | in-place | Create a firewall rule opening sshd to source_cidr, for when Tailscale and IAP are both unavailable. |
| `break_glass.source_cidr` | string | *(empty)* | in-place | Your public address as /32 (IPv4) or /128 (IPv6). Required when enabled. 0.0.0.0/0 is refused. |
| `break_glass.allow_mosh` | bool | `false` | in-place | Also open udp:60000-61000 to source_cidr. |

## Tiers

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| identity | Selects a different box. Changing it addresses new resources; the old ones are left alone. |
| in-place | `devbox apply` updates the GCP resource. The instance is not touched. |
| reprovision | `devbox apply` updates instance metadata (and grows disks); `devbox reprovision` applies it on the box. No session lost. |
| restart | `devbox apply` stops and starts the instance. Disks survive; tmux sessions do not. |
| replace | `devbox apply` deletes and recreates the instance. `/srv/code` survives; home directories and sessions do not. |
| refused | Not implemented. Setting it is an error. |

A change to `cloud-init.yaml` in the binary itself is also **replace** tier. A change to `provision.sh` is **reprovision** tier.
